raw: {"synthesis": "Rakuen Software is a New Zealand software company headquartered in Auckland, founded in 2016. It employs 42 engineers as of 2026. Its principal product is aimee, an autonomous engineering assistant. The company operates a single office in Auckland. aimee is released under the AGPL-3.0 license."}

{"synthesis": "The Proxmox host pve is located at IP address 192.168.1.253 and has 28 CPU threads, 125 GB of RAM, and an NVIDIA RTX 5080 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. It provides 888 GB of ZFS storage for container root filesystems through an Optane pool. The host currently runs 45 containers and uses NVIDIA driver version 610.43.02."}

{"synthesis": "Klaus is based in Munich, works for Siemens, runs the infrastructure group for six years, meets at conferences, drives a 1987 Land Cruiser, and has collaborated with the author for about a decade."}

{"synthesis": "The retention policy is governed by the security working group and requires audit records to be kept for seven years. The policy is reviewed annually and applies only to audit records, not to user content."}

{"synthesis": "Tier-A covers the mechanical curator stages: extract_docs, extract_code, index_narrative, index_claims, index_code_unit and link_artifacts. Tier-A sets disable_thinking on the provider. The memory_facts drain runs one completion per note. The seed ontology defines 17 canonical relations. Extracted facts are gated by memory_fact_gate before being committed as semantic edges. Tier-B covers the reasoning stages including judge and synthesize. Committed typed facts are auto-injected into every turn."}
